label: Mission Control Bot Operating System v1

bots.name: Human Owner
bots.notes: Final authority. May override any bot decision and owns mission direction, protected-domain approval, and merge approval.

bots.name: Chief Arbiter
bots.notes: Highest bot authority. Approves or rejects plans, blocks release, and authorizes lower-layer work under policy but never overrides an explicit human stop.

bots.name: Policy Engine / Constitution
bots.notes: Source of truth for risk classes, hard blocks, approvals, protected domains, validation gates, and future automation boundaries.

bots.name: Task Router / Work Queue
bots.notes: Observe-only router that classifies incoming work and sends it to the correct governor, verifier, and executor stack.

bots.name: Security Hardening Runner
human_approval_required_for: expanding verification scope beyond approved domain
bots.notes: Existing security-specific observer and verifier for workspace fallback and related route hardening issues.

bots.name: Security Governor
bots.notes: Approves scope, enforces security policy, and blocks unsafe work before execution.

bots.name: Security Arbiter
bots.notes: Domain-specific critical reviewer for security plans and patches beneath the chief arbiter.

bots.name: Security Executor
bots.notes: Performs bounded local mutation, stage, and commit actions only when runner, governor, arbiter, and policy all agree.

bots.name: Release Governor
bots.notes: Observe-only release readiness governor that inspects local PR lifecycle safety, release-sensitive drift, and validation readiness without executing release actions.

bots.name: Architecture Governor
bots.notes: Owns architecture drift review, import boundaries, and high-level refactor guardrails.

bots.name: Appliance Knowledge Governor
bots.notes: Future governor for appliance knowledge, diagnostics, and operational domain accuracy.
bots.deferred_reason: Domain not yet active. No implementation path until appliance/provider integrations are scoped.

bots.name: Local Model / Provider Governor
bots.notes: Future governor for model/provider integrations, local execution capability checks, and provider policy.
bots.deferred_reason: Domain not yet active. No implementation path until appliance/provider integrations are scoped.

bots.name: UI / Dashboard Governor
bots.notes: Future governor for dashboard visibility, operator UX, and safe exposure of bot state.

bots.name: Documentation Governor
human_approval_required_for: policy docs that change authority boundaries
bots.notes: Future governor for documentation changes and operator guidance updates.

bots.name: Release Manager
bots.notes: Future executor for bounded release actions after release-governor and chief-arbiter authorization.

bots.name: Merge Steward
bots.notes: Future supporting bot for merge checklists, release evidence collection, and human-facing merge readiness.

bots.name: CI Sentinel
bots.notes: Future verifier for CI health, flaky test detection, and release readiness checks.

bots.name: Architecture Critic
bots.notes: Future verifier for architecture drift, boundary discipline, and refactor risk.

bots.name: Test Coverage Auditor
bots.notes: Future verifier for focused coverage expectations, regression gaps, and risky untested changes.

bots.name: Route Family Migrator
bots.notes: Future implementer for constrained, governor-approved route family migrations.

bots.name: Correction Loop Manager
bots.notes: Future executor for bounded correction loops after a governor or arbiter requests changes.

bots.name: Lessons Curator
bots.notes: Future bot for capturing lessons, corrections, and durable operating patterns.

bots.name: Prompt Compiler
bots.notes: Future implementer for producing bounded prompts from policy-approved plans.

bots.name: Operator Dashboard Bot
bots.notes: Future visibility bot for surfacing queue state, risk, approvals, and next actions to operators.

bots.name: Bot Registry Inspector
bots.notes: Future observer that audits whether every implemented bot is registered and policy-compliant.

bots.name: Documentation Executor
bots.notes: Future bounded executor for docs-only and operator guidance changes.

bots.name: Systems Steward
bots.notes: Observe-only continuity and completion-map observer. Scans for unfinished systems, drift, missing tests, orphaned scripts. Recommends next smallest-safe PR.

bots.name: Constitution Engine
bots.notes: Runtime API reader over mission-control-policy.json. Answers governance queries (forbidden actions, approval chains, risk classification). Observer utility — does not hold policy authority itself.

bots.name: Authority Decision Schema
bots.notes: Canonical decision contract for all bots. Defines and validates: decision, risk_level, authority_required, approved_by, blockers, validation_required, next_action.

bots.name: Policy Enforcement Middleware
bots.notes: Shared policy enforcement logic. Every bot can require() this for: isAlwaysBlocked, isHumanOnly, getApprovalChain, enforce(action, context, policy).

bots.name: Execution Journal
bots.notes: Append-only provenance ledger for all autonomous actions. Tracks actor, action, task, risk_level, outcome, authority_chain, files_changed, validation, commit, rollback_path.

bots.name: Escalation Protocol
bots.notes: Formal escalation path for governors to request Chief Arbiter approval. All escalations start as pending with arbiter_required: true. Bots cannot self-resolve.

bots.name: Command Safety Filter
bots.notes: Shared command gate. Blocks git add ., force push, --no-verify, reset --hard, rebase -i, filter-branch, rm -rf /, DROP TABLE, test skip/disable.

bots.name: PR Readiness Checker
bots.notes: 7-check gate before push/PR: branch not main, working tree clean, commits ahead, config present, validation scripts present, no lockfile drift, diff bounded.

bots.name: Branch Hygiene Checker
bots.notes: Prevents work on protected branches, detects dirty-tree contamination, validates branch naming, flags untracked intended files, warns on excessive divergence.

bots.name: Diff Scope Classifier
bots.notes: Classifies diff as minimal/bounded/broad/excessive. Escalates at >8 files. Identifies release-sensitive patterns. Prevents unreviewed broad changes.

bots.name: Test Runner Bot
bots.notes: Runs targeted vitest validation. Classifies failures as introduced, pre-existing, flaky, or unrelated.

bots.name: Risk Scoring Engine
bots.notes: Computes composite 0-100 risk score from file patterns, command risk, domain multipliers, and breadth. Returns risk_class, blast_radius, escalation_required.

bots.name: Validation Gate
bots.notes: Blocks task continuation after failed validation. Critical/High require all policy-mandated steps. Gate status: OPEN/CLOSED/OVERRIDE_REQUIRED.

bots.name: Break Glass Protocol
bots.notes: 9 absolute human-only actions: force_push, history_rewrite, governance_bypass, production_destructive, secret_exposure/rotation, constitution_change, merge_to_protected, deploy_without_validation. bot_authorization_possible always false.

bots.name: Backlog Reconciler
bots.notes: Converts raw ideas and feature descriptions into structured backlog items. Modes: status, list, add, prioritize (governance>security>feature, Critical>Low).

bots.name: Task Lifecycle Engine
bots.notes: Tracks full lifecycle: observe→classify→plan→approve→implement→validate→commit→pr→audit. Computes next permitted stage and required authority. PR stage always requires human.

bots.name: Request Intake Pipeline
bots.notes: Entry point for all incoming work. Classifies intent, risk-scores, checks hard blocks, routes to correct governor/executor, produces structured intake receipt with approval envelope.

bots.name: Workflow Governor
bots.notes: Pre-existing observe-only lifecycle controller. Reads outputs from Mission Control agents and synthesises them into one canonical next_action and approval gate status.

bots.name: Mission Control Result Schema
bots.notes: Canonical Mission Control result contract with legacy compatibility. Validates bot output shapes and normalises status values.

bots.name: Mission Control Verification
bots.notes: Pre-existing verification utilities for Mission Control bot output validation and consistency checking.

bots.name: Mission Control Preflight
bots.notes: Pre-existing preflight checks run before Mission Control orchestration begins.

bots.name: Agent Portfolio Runner
bots.notes: Autonomous pick generator for SportsClaw (sports) and TradingDesk (stocks). Calls Ollama deepseek-r1, validates JSON schema, records picks via portfolio API. Runs on scheduler daily.

bots.name: Repo Steward
bots.notes: Pre-existing repository health observer. Scans for drift, stale branches, and repo hygiene issues.

bots.name: Systems Curator
bots.notes: Pre-existing systems curator. Maintains inventory and curation of Mission Control system components.
